picks.title: Energy Star 9000 BTU Mini Split AC/Heating System 23 SEER2 230V
feature_bullets: Energy Star & 23 SEER2 Ultra Energy-Saving: This ductless mini split heat pump is officially Energy Star certified, meeting strict US high-efficiency energy standards for low-power and eco operation. Equipped with an upgraded smart inverter compressor and precise temperature control system, it boasts a 23 SEER2 rating, effectively avoiding frequent startup and shutdown and redundant energy waste. It maintains stable indoor temperatures all year round, delivering powerful cooling and heating performance while drastically cutting daily and monthly electricity consumption, bringing energy-saving and cost-reducing benefits for long-term home use

Extreme Weather Adaptability: Designed for harsh temperature conditions, the outdoor unit comes with chassis electric heating support, enabling stable operation in extreme climates. It delivers efficient cooling at up to 140°F in scorching summer and steady heating at as low as -13°F in freezing winter, ensuring reliable home comfort regardless of extreme outdoor weather changes

Multi Functional Modes: This smart ductless mini split supports precise remote control operation. It offers 7 working modes (Auto, Cool, Heat, Dry, Fan, ECO, Sleep), 8 adjustable fan speeds, 24-hour programmable timer, and child-lock function, fully meeting daily family comfort and safety needs

picks.title: 9000 BTU Mini Split AC/Heating System 115V 18 SEER2
feature_bullets: Energy Saving & Ultra-Low Sleep Noise: Built with efficient inverter technology, this mini split air conditioner greatly reduces power draw even under continuous full-load operation. Three separate ECO energy-saving modes are available for personalized power management. You can toggle between modes based on room temperature, operating hours and the number of users to maintain ideal cooling comfort while keeping electricity costs in check. Its exclusive sleep mode drops operating noise to as low as 31dB, supplying smooth, near-silent airflow for quiet nighttime rest.

Remote Control: Conveniently adjust your air conditioner from across the room using the remote. Power the unit on or off, tweak temperatures, change fan speeds, redirect airflow, and pick modes including dehumidification and sleep mode with ease. The integrated timer helps schedule operation to save energy and enhance your comfort. Note: The 9000 BTU model has no built-in Wi-Fi, so APP and WIFI connectivity are not supported.

Multi-Mode Intelligent Control & 4D Full-Range Airflow System: This mini split air conditioner features 8 practical working modes-Cool, Heat, Dry, Fan, Sleep, Auto, ECO and Care-to satisfy year-round cooling and heating demands. There are 7 selectable fan speeds, letting you easily shift between soft silent breeze and strong powerful airflow as preferred. Outfitted with 4D auto air swing technology, it circulates air evenly throughout the room for fully immersive comfort.
